definitions.active_minutes: ended_at-started_at; session interval duration, distinct from connection including post-charge occupation.
definitions.attempt_count: Initial platform requests in interior window, including failed/cancelled/queued requests; not electrical handshakes.
definitions.connected_minutes: unplugged_at-started_at; includes post-charge OCCUPIED, excludes initial queue/reservation waits.
definitions.energy_kwh: Telemetry output Wh summed over selected intervals /1000, not nameplate-derived energy or session totals assigned to the starting hour.
definitions.energy_ledger: Entire dataset window; interval totals cannot be exactly cut across interior/day boundaries without extra assumptions. External charging is SIMULATED and excluded from platform income and meters.
definitions.hour_denominator: charger_count * selected_day_type_days * 3600 for EACH clock hour; zero-day cohorts return null, not zero utilization.
definitions.hour_index: All 24-element arrays are local clock hours 0..23; Mon-Fri versus Sat-Sun, no holiday adjustment.
definitions.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; null when no observations; memory proportional to sessions, not telemetry.
definitions.repeat_gap: Consecutive canonical platform sessions of the same vehicle, both starts inside interior window; report start-to-start and previous-unplug-to-next-start hours.
definitions.session_cohort: Canonical sessions fully contained inside interior window: started_at >= window start and unplugged_at <= window end. Crossing sessions excluded from quantiles, but their interior telemetry still contributes.
definitions.utilization: Percent of installed charger-seconds: CHARGING / denominator, or (CHARGING+OCCUPIED) / denominator. RESERVED, MAINTENANCE and OFFLINE remain in denominator.
definitions.weather: Interior-window hourly rows grouped by local month; averages of the available same-city hourly background, not city-wide station observations.

limitations: Generated behavior diagnostics are not evidence of real-market representativeness or forecast accuracy.
First and last business days excluded due to empty initialization and clipped final stays.
Checksums, schemas, cleaning and telemetry coverage checked here; run validate.py for full business/financial/energy consistency.
Reference aggregates are not read; all statistics computed from raw files, not presented as Spark output.
